_comment: Lightning Wizard Action (Instant). Deal 3 arcane damage to any target. Starfall - If an instant card has been put into your graveyard this turn, create a Lightning Flow token. Starfall keyword fires from card DB but is a clause marker only; CONDITIONAL_EFFECT + EVENT_THIS_TURN graveyard/instant is the documented pattern (DSL_REFERENCE). DEAL_ARCANE target ANY_TARGET supported by handler (comet_collision_red finding). Release note: target declared at play, Starfall checked at resolution, no priority between effects; if target no longer exists, token still created. Token lightning_flow needs its own JSON in json/tokens/. GAP: play-time target declaration for 'any target' not fully expressible in DSL (cosmic_suture_red precedent).
